item.description: Halfway through cookie season, transgender Girl Scouts have sold more than 71,000 boxes — and they're still going. item.title: Meet all 41 LGBTQ+ Olympians at the 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: It’s finally time for the 2026 Winter Games, and there are enough queer athletes competing this time around that you’ll be able to root for an LGBTQ+ Olympian in most of the events. There were 193 queer athletes who competed in the 2024 Paris Olympics, making them the queerest Olympics in history, and while there are a lot fewer at the Milano Cortina Games, there will still be a huge amount of representation on your TV screen.
